name: caspase recruitment domain family member 11

function.text: CARD11 encodes caspase recruitment domain-containing protein 11. Annotated molecular activities include GMP kinase activity and signaling adaptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to BENTA disease (autosomal dominant); immunodeficiency 11b with atopic dermatitis (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Sézary syndrome; Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: CARD11 encodes caspase recruitment domain-containing protein 11. It participates in signal transduction and canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction. Functional annotations also associate the protein with GMP kinase activity and signaling adaptor activity.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with BENTA disease (autosomal dominant); immunodeficiency 11b with atopic dermatitis (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CARD11 have been reported in sézary syndrome, diffuse large b-cell lymphoma, and adult t-cell leukemia/lymphoma.
